descriptions.zh-Hans: 路边摊主在废纸上画的路线，折起来正好塞进口袋。最深的一道折痕刚好穿过转弯处。
descriptions.en: A stallholder sketched the way on a scrap of paper. Its deepest fold lands right on the turning.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 垫过一杯热茶的小纸片，店主说可以带走。水印比杯子更早凉下来。
descriptions.en: The shopkeeper let this little paper coaster leave with me. A pale ring is all that remains of the warm cup.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 帮店主按住包纸时，他把剪下的细绳送给了我。绳头还卷着刚才那个结的形状。
descriptions.en: I held the wrapping steady; the shopkeeper gave me the spare twine. One end still remembers the knot.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 柜台上试盖印章的小纸，收信的人说这一张不必扔。印圈缺了一小口，倒很像在笑。
descriptions.en: A practice stamp from the mail counter, rescued with permission. The gap in its circle looks rather cheerful.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 等候时，邻座把一张不用的纸折成了船送我。船头有点歪，平放着也像要出发。
descriptions.en: Someone waiting beside me folded this from spare paper. Its crooked bow gives it a sense of purpose, even on a shelf.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 路边捡到的一小片旧陶，边角已经磨圆。翻过来，背面还有半道浅浅的手指纹。
descriptions.en: A worn pottery chip found beside the path. The smooth back still holds part of a faint fingerprint.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 邻座用半截铅笔画的小窗，纸不够大，只装下了半扇。他把画送给我，说另外半扇留给下次。
descriptions.en: Someone sitting beside me drew half a window with a stub of pencil. The paper was too small for the rest, so he gave me this half and saved the other for another visit.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 店主收好茶叶后，把干净的空纸袋递给了我。轻轻压平，还能闻到一点淡香。
descriptions.en: An empty paper packet from the tea counter. Flatten it gently and a little of the scent is still there.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 同行的人分给我一颗糖，糖纸一路沙沙响。展平以后，中间留下了一颗小太阳似的折痕。
descriptions.en: A fellow traveler shared a sweet. The wrapper kept rustling afterward; opened flat, its creases make a tiny sun.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 等候时有人折了一把小纸扇送我，又慢慢教了一遍折法。最后一格是我们一起压平的。
descriptions.en: Someone folded me a little paper fan during a wait, then slowly showed me how. We pressed the final fold flat together.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 裁缝从布边剪下一小条，替我把散线收好。夹进书里，露出的部分刚好够抓住。
descriptions.en: A tailor tidied the loose threads on this narrow offcut. It makes a bookmark with just enough cloth left to hold.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 摊主在余纸上描下碗沿那圈歪歪的线，收碗时把纸送给了我。每一段都不一样，像一路走一路想出来的。
descriptions.en: The stallholder copied the wavy line around a bowl onto spare paper and gave me the drawing. No stretch quite repeats another.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 同一张问路纸经过三个人的手，各添了一个小箭头。最后一个人还画了回头招手的自己。
descriptions.en: Three people added arrows to this one sheet of directions. The last drew a tiny self-portrait, waving me along.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我画完椅子，旁边的人替它添上了一位等车的客人，又把纸送给我留着。纸翻过来，还有我们各画的一只鞋。
descriptions.en: I drew a chair; someone beside me added a waiting passenger and let me keep the sheet. On the back we each drew a shoe.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 店主本来要扔的小纸盒，被我们用两片余纸补好了角。他笑着说，这回总得找个人好好留着。
descriptions.en: Two scraps of paper saved this box from the bin. The shopkeeper decided that after so much repair work, it deserved a home.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我总急着端杯子，店主便写了“再等一等”放在旁边。等到茶能喝了，他又在后面添了一个小勾。
descriptions.en: When I kept reaching for a hot cup, the shopkeeper wrote “a little longer.” The check mark came once it was ready to drink.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 看裁缝补衣服看了半天，他用两块余布拼出一枚小补丁送我。两边颜色不同，针脚却排得一样齐。
descriptions.en: After I watched a tailor at work, he joined two offcuts into a patch for me. Different colours, equally patient stitches.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 修灯的人拿余纸示范了一遍折法，再把小灯罩递给我。里面没装灯，朝着亮处举起来也很好看。
descriptions.en: A lamp repairer demonstrated the folds with spare paper, then let me keep the little shade. It looks lovely held up to the light.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 一场长雨把五个陌生人留在同一处屋檐下，大家轮流在纸上添画，直到雨停。临走时他们把这卷没写名字的小故事交给了我。
descriptions.en: Five strangers, one shelter, and a long shower became a story drawn in turns. When the rain ended, they asked me to keep the little paper scroll.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 两位走散多年的老友在我歇脚的长椅前认出了彼此，请路过的摄影师留了影。我替他们按平衣领，也分到了一张笑得有点模糊的照片。
descriptions.en: Two old friends recognized each other beside my resting bench and stopped a photographer. I straightened their collars and received a print, with the laughter slightly out of focus.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 陪修灯的老人扶了一夜的手电，直到第一拨行人经过，那盏旧灯才重新亮起来。他用修灯剩下的纸做了这个小灯罩，说我们也该留一盏。
descriptions.en: I held a torch for an elderly repairer until the old lamp finally lit, just before the first passersby arrived. This tiny shade was made from the leftover paper: a light for us to keep.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 送行的人群散去后，我和一位老人把被挤破的纸扇一点点补齐。最后一班车开走前，他把扇子留给我，自己拿着那张画满修补办法的纸上了车。
descriptions.en: After a crowded farewell, an older traveler and I patiently patched this torn fan. Before the last departure, he gave me the fan and took our sheet of repair sketches instead.
